text:
Maya: quick sync — thinking about tuning the partner beta onramp / waitlist. goal = a high-signal early cohort without burning SE cycles. proposing: canary 10, main cohort 30, 2-week trial, 3 engagement signals to qualify. thoughts?
Alex: sounds reasonable but 30 might be tight for diversity across use cases. can we do 40 and stagger start dates?
Kelly: +1 to stagger. also worried about support load if we open too many at once — need clear SLAs and playbook for triage. :warning:
Sam: can we define the 3 engagement signals now? my suggestion: 1) weekly active integration (calls to API > X), 2) qualitative feedback submitted in form, 3) at least one production-ish test flow configured.
Lina: outreach cadence idea — 3-touch before invite (email -> product demo -> short setup call). screening form snippet I used before:
```
1) Primary use case
2) Expected monthly token volume
3) Security/compliance constraints
4) Commitment (weekly check-ins?)
```
Maya: that screening form looks good. for metrics, Sam — can you propose exact thresholds for API calls and feedback completeness?
Sam: propose API > 500 tokens/day on average over 7 days OR 3 meaningful evals uploaded; feedback form completion = >=80% questions answered. also capture NPS at end of 2 weeks.
Alex: add requirement to flag any customer with dedicated infra needs (VPC/onprem) — they need legal + infra lead before invite.
Kelly: we should surface all invites in the ops channel and attach a small runbook for oncall handoff. Eng-bot can auto-post new cohort members.
Eng-bot: new_cohort_event -> will post reminders and create support tag when cohort size > 10.
Lina: incentive options: 1) extended trial credits, 2) priority cadence + dedicated SE office hours for canary, 3) early feature access. Recommend split incentives: canary gets SE hours, main cohort gets credits.
Maya: launch criteria checklist draft: 
- canary (10) complete 2 weeks with >=70% engagement signals
- no critical quality regressions in automated evals
- support playbook validated with 2 SE triages
- feedback loop (form + one interview) scheduled for >=80% of cohort
If all green, roll to main cohort.
Alex: +1. add cost guardrail: projected token spend not to exceed monthly budget X without explicit approval.
Sam: action items: I'll write thresholds + GA dashboard events; Lina will finalize screening form and cadence; Kelly will prepare support playbook; Maya will schedule invites and legal check for infra cases.
Maya: thanks — let's sync Friday 11am to approve the canary list. :thumbsup:
